/accessionID: The name may identify a repository, and its URL may be a repository landing page; do not manufacture an accession.
/assemblyAuthor: Do not use metadataAuthor as assembly creator; preserve order/nameType separately.
/assemblyProtocol: A protocol reference is not automatically a HowTo, source dataset, or derivation relation.
/assemblySoftware: Keep the ordered structured software provenance, including versions and command-line arrays.
/checksum: File checksum is not a DOI/ARK; no file verification is performed.
/dateCreated: This is not the publication, deposit, metadata-record creation, or specimen collection date.
/documentation: This field is free text and is not necessarily a resolvable documentation URI.
/funding: Free text does not supply funder identities, award numbers or grant relationships.
/genome: An organism/reference label is not necessarily a citation title; title comes from explicit context.
/genomeSynonym: Do not promote common genome names to alternative assembly citation titles without a reviewed assertion.
/identifier: Identifier scheme, resource/version scope and identity equivalence need separate review before projection.
/instrument: No direct instrument slot is asserted in this descriptive DCMI profile.
/masking: Keep the reported masking category; it is not a license, identifier or controlled DCMI subject.
/metadataAuthor: RDF creator links are unordered; preserve source array order and nameType in the source sidecar.
/relatedLink: Original order is retained in the source; no derivation or citation direction is inferred.
/reuseConditions: Do not infer a standard license URI or reuse the software/site license.
/schema: Record identity must be supplied separately; never assert that the assembly is a JSON metadata record.
/schemaVersion: DCMI has no direct metadata-contract version property; keep the cited contract version separately from resource version.
/scholarlyArticle: An untyped relation does not assert isDescribedBy; the article DOI never becomes the assembly identifier.
/seqcol_id: A supplied sequence-collection digest is not a file checksum or registered resource DOI/ARK.
/taxon: Taxon name and object structure remain in the source; no invented subject scheme or geographic data.
/version: No literal dcterms:version exists; hasVersion/isVersionOf require resource relationships, not a version string.
/vitalStats: Keep typed metrics/units and source context; no general-purpose bibliographic identifier mapping.
/voucherSpecimen: Keep the current free text; no structured specimen or source-material assertion is introduced.
